text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, do you still have that
gathered frill blouse
with the ribbon on the chest in stock?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It caught my eye when I came here before.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that item actually sold out
just yesterday...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Too bad...
Looks like I missed my chance...)
